column1: # Known failures that the reopen gate (tools/orbstack/reopen-e2e.sh) accepts.
# One entry per line, tab-separated: <check> <reason regex> <issue>.
# <check> is the exact text between PASS/FAIL and the colon. A failure is
# accepted only when its reason matches the regex; any other failure of the
# same check stays a FAIL. The runner lists entries that did not fire, so
# remove an entry when its defect is fixed.
F20 rmain a: unmount without discard succeeds after the commit
F20 rmain b: unmount with discard deletes the reopened overlay file
F35 setup: a new saved Workspace, then SIGKILL
